services.title: Services
services.description: Manage machines and ports under each service. Agents look up a service name and receive only healthy endpoints.
services.name: Service name
services.formHelp: Set the service name and its health check.
services.emptyHelp: Register a service, then add its machines and ports.
services.deleteHelp: This service and all its machine and port records will be deleted.

instances.title: Machines & ports
instances.emptyHelp: Add the first machine and port under this service.
instances.enabledHelp: When disabled, agents will not receive this endpoint even if it is healthy.
instances.deleteHelp: This machine and port will be removed from the service.
instances.drainHelp: Stop new discoveries for this instance. Keep the application running until existing requests finish, then deregister it. Renewal will not reactivate a draining instance.

health.typeHelp: TCP checks connections; HTTP requires 2xx; gRPC requires the standard health service to report SERVING.
health.timingHelp: Use 0 for interval or timeout to inherit the center setting.

validation.nameLength: Name must be at most 80 characters
validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 300 characters
validation.address: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address
validation.healthPath: An HTTP health path must start with / and be at most 200 characters
validation.protection: Enter a value within the supported range
validation.metadata: Enter a JSON object with string keys and string values

errors.network_error: Cannot reach the registry. Check that the Go server is running.
errors.internal_error: The server failed to process the request.
errors.port_in_use: This machine and port are already assigned to another service.
errors.managed_instance: SDK-managed instances are updated by their registration lease.
errors.not_found: The record no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.invalid_instance_metadata: Invalid instance version, weight or metadata.
errors.registration_conflict: The registration token belongs to another endpoint.

protection.title: Self protection
protection.help: Health failures still leave the normal discovery list. Historical fallback requires both this setting and explicit caller opt-in.
protection.activeHelp: Records are retained temporarily. Disabled and draining instances remain excluded.
protection.renewal_drop: A large number of heartbeats are missing.
protection.recovery_cleanup: Expired instances are being removed gradually.
